critic.argument: The claim rests on a single low-engagement RSS item with no corroboration, no methodology, no benchmarks, and no independent verification. The underlying observation reduces to a product-policy anecdote: one model surfaces a capability while two gate it. No mechanism, scope, error rate, or reliability data is provided. The evidence is thin, uncorroborated, and self-referentially circular (the source asserts the claim; the claim cites the source).
